subject.title: fix: inbound messages can be reprocessed after gateway restart or reconnect (persistent replay dedupe + bounded durable replay)

question: Should PR 99365 land with the new public channel-outbound durable inbound replay API and the WhatsApp five-attempt dead-letter policy, or should either be narrowed before merge?
rationale: The code path is a plausible best fix, but the public Plugin SDK contract and message dead-letter policy are compatibility and delivery choices that automation cannot safely decide for maintainers.

options.title: Accept API and delivery policy
options.body: Approve the documented public durable replay helper/types and the five-attempt WhatsApp dead-letter behavior, then proceed once exact-head checks are acceptable.

options.title: Keep replay helper internal for now
options.body: Remove or narrow the public exports, docs, and baseline changes while preserving the channel bug fixes through an internal seam.

options.title: Change the WhatsApp replay policy
options.body: Choose a different cap or operator-controlled policy before merging the dead-letter behavior.

recommendation.title: Accept API and delivery policy
recommendation.body: Approve the documented public durable replay helper/types and the five-attempt WhatsApp dead-letter behavior, then proceed once exact-head checks are acceptable.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent ingress recovery work and the PR discussion point to Vincent Koc for the channel/message-runtime replay decision.
